item.title: 'Smart decision': Swalwell's resignation spurs praise from both parties after bombshell allegations emerge
item.summary: Rep. Eric Swalwell, D-Calif., announced he was planning to resign from Congress following sexual misconduct allegations, leading top Democrats in the U.S. Senate to praise the decision.

item.title: Swalwell's 'best friend' in Congress turns on him after bombshell allegations torpedo his political career
item.summary: Sen. Ruben Gallego, D-Ariz., distanced himself from Rep. Eric Swalwell, D-Calif., calling him unfit for Congress after allegations of sexual assault and misconduct.

item.title: DoorDash driver hails key Trump policy after delivering McDonald's to White House: 'I'm going to enjoy it'
item.summary: DoorDash driver Sharron Simmons says she hopes Trump's no-tax-on-tips benefit in the One Big Beautiful Bill extends beyond its current 2028 expiration.

item.title: Dick Vitale announces fifth cancer diagnosis as biopsy confirms melanoma in his lung and liver cavity
item.summary: Dick Vitale said he is confident he will go "5 for 5" after a biopsy confirmed melanoma in his lung and liver cavity for his fifth cancer diagnosis.

item.title: US military kills 2 suspected cartel operatives in latest Eastern Pacific lethal strike, SOUTHCOM says
item.summary: The U.S. military killed two men believed to be cartel operatives in the Eastern Pacific as part of broader efforts to disrupt narcotics trafficking.

item.title: JD Vance says the ball is 'in Iran’s court' after Pakistan peace talks stall
item.summary: VP JD Vance rejects reports Pakistan talks failed, says Iran negotiations made progress but Iranian team was unable to finalize a deal in talks.

item.title: Sydney Sweeney’s ‘Euphoria’ return sparks backlash as fans slam ‘humiliating’ storyline
item.summary: Viewers denounce "Euphoria's" creative direction after season three opener, saying Sydney Sweeney's provocative scenes as Cassie Howard are humiliating.

item.title: Sunny Hostin doesn't know if president is the 'right position' for Harris, urges her to reconsider CA governor
item.summary: "The View" co-host Sunny Hostin said she wanted Kamala Harris to reconsider running for California governor, though co-host Ana Navarro noted the deadline passed for entering the race.

item.title: Embattled Rep Tony Gonzales announces plans to resign amid sexual misconduct allegations
item.summary: Rep. Tony Gonzales, R-Texas, will resign from Congress after facing sexual misconduct allegations.

item.title: Dave McGinnis, former Cardinals head coach and beloved Titans assistant, dead at 74
item.summary: Dave McGinnis, former Arizona Cardinals head coach and longtime Tennessee Titans assistant coach and broadcaster, has died at age 74 after an illness.
